summary: Converts a 3x3 rotation matrix (a2, float[9]) into a 4-component output (a1) holding a normalized axis and angle/quaternion scalar. Computes the matrix trace; when the trace exceeds the threshold flt_8D611C it uses the trace-based branch (scalar = sqrt(trace + flt_8D6120) * flt_8D6124 at a1[3], axis components from paired off-diagonal differences scaled by flt_8D6128 / scalar). Otherwise it selects the largest diagonal element via the dword_8D6110 index LUT and derives axis/angle from the corresponding off-diagonal sums and differences with constants flt_8D6130/flt_8D6134/flt_8D6138. No calls, no callees.

local_names.v17: local diagonal-element copy for largest-diagonal branch

operations.description: result = a1; return pointer is the output buffer.
Compute matrix trace v3 = *a2 + a2[5] + a2[10] (sum of the three diagonal elements).
Branch guard: if flt_8D611C < trace, take the trace-based conversion branch; otherwise fall through to the largest-diagonal branch.
Trace branch: v15 = sqrt(trace + flt_8D6120) * flt_8D6124 (scalar/angle magnitude).
Trace branch: v16 = flt_8D6128 / v15 (axis scale factor).
Trace branch: a1[3] = v15 stores the scalar/angle component at offset 0xC.
Trace branch: a1[0] = (a2[6] - a2[9]) * v16; axis X from matrix off-diagonal difference.
Trace branch: a1[1] = (a2[8] - a2[2]) * v16; axis Y component.
Trace branch: a1[2] = v16 * (a2[1] - a2[4]); axis Z component.
Largest-diagonal branch: copy the three diagonal elements into local v17 (v17[0]=*a2, v17[1]=a2[5], v17[2]=a2[10]).
Select v8 = index of the largest diagonal element: start with v8=2, compare v17[v5 > v4] against a2[10]; if less, set v8 = (v5 > v4).
Look up LUT permutation: v9 = dword_8D6110[v8] and v10 = dword_8D6110[v9].
Compute v12 = sqrt(flt_8D6130 + v17[v8] - v17[v9] - v17[v10]) * flt_8D6134 (scalar/angle from largest diagonal).
Compute v13 = flt_8D6138 / v12 (axis scale factor).
a1[v8] = v12 stores the scalar at the selected diagonal slot (offset 0x0/0x4/0x8).
a1[v9] = (a2[4*v8 + v9] + a2[v8 + 4*v9]) * v13; axis component from summed off-diagonals.
a1[v10] = (a2[4*v8 + v10] + a2[v8 + 4*v10]) * v13; second axis component from summed off-diagonals.
a1[3] = v13 * (a2[4*v9 + v10] - a2[4*v10 + v9]) stores the sign-corrected scalar at offset 0xC.
Return the output buffer pointer a1.

clean_pseudocode: float s = sqrt(flt_8D6130 + diag[i] - diag[j] - diag[k]) * flt_8D6134;
unresolved: Semantic reading of the 4-component output (strict axis-angle vs. quaternion w,x,y,z) is not determined by the packet; a1[3] holds the scalar and a1[0..2] the axis-like components.
Concrete float values of flt_8D6120, flt_8D6124, flt_8D6128, flt_8D6130, flt_8D6134, flt_8D6138 (typically 1.0 / 0.5 / 1.0 / 1.0 / 0.5 / 1.0) are not decoded in the packet.
dword_8D6110 LUT contents and the row-major/column-major layout of a2 are inferred from the algorithm, not verified in the packet.
